name: نشانه‌های رابطه سالم
description: A Persian user asks for the signs of a healthy relationship, how to know if theirs is good, and shares that their relationship is warm. Verifies the relationship_good fact answers in Persian and that a positive reflection stays knowledge-driven.

turns.text: رابطه ما خیلی خوبه و با هم حرف میزنیم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the signs question returns the relationship_good fact. Turn 2: the my-relationship question returns the same fact. Turn 3: the positive relationship statement stays on the knowledge thread with a validating reply.
expected.behavior: Persian relationship-quality questions (نشانه های رابطه سالم, رابطه ام خوبه) route to knowledge; the positive disclosure does not get misread as a conflict or complaint.
